interface.import: from models.retrieval.retrieval import retrieve, search, add_to_index, warm_up, reset_index
interface.retrieve: retrieve(text, k, filters=None): related reports for a new message
interface.search: search(query, filters=None, k=20): keyword search ranked by TF-IDF word matching with every word kept; an empty query lists filtered reports newest first
interface.add_to_index: add_to_index(message): add or update a saved user report (stored-message fields, optional location)
interface.warm_up: warm_up(): load the indexes and model once when the server starts
interface.reset_index: reset_index(): reload the saved indexes after a rebuild, dropping in-memory user reports
interface.result_field_notes: The first five fields are the shared result fields. duplicate_count and duplicate_ids list near-copies grouped under the result. text_preview is the original message (emoji and web-page codes repaired), cut at 200 characters. similarity is None for an empty search.
interface.optional_arguments: method='semantic' or 'tfidf' (default: semantic for retrieve(), tfidf for search()); exclude_ids to leave out given IDs

methods_used.reason: retrieve() uses the method selected by the evaluation; search() is designed for keyword searching, so it ranks by TF-IDF word matching

tfidf.search_index: search() uses the same settings with min_df=1 (every word kept), built in memory from all records on first use and rebuilt on the next search after add_to_index()

data.source: HumAID event-wise release (QCRI/HumAID-events), downloaded by notebooks/01_crisis_eda.ipynb

cleaning: repair broken emoji and web-page codes such as &
drop '#' and keep the hashtag word
cleaning_note: One cleaned text is used for ranking (both methods) and duplicate grouping; the original text is kept for display.

added.created_after: keep reports created on or after this date or time (UTC)
added.created_before: keep reports created on or before this date or time (UTC)

filters.notes: Each filter takes one value or a list. Location, status and needs_review exist only for user reports. Empty values are ignored and an unknown filter name raises an error.

duplicate_grouping.rule: a result is grouped under an earlier one when their TF-IDF cosine similarity reaches the threshold; the same rule applies to both methods
duplicate_grouping.limitation: only the best-scoring candidates (max(200, 20 x k)) are checked

setup.step: uv run jupyter lab, then run notebooks/01_crisis_eda.ipynb

backend_notes: Call warm_up() once at server start, after adding the saved user reports.
The first search after add_to_index() rebuilds the search index (under a second), so every word in the new report can be searched.
User reports added with add_to_index() are held in memory; add the saved user reports again at server start.
Call add_to_index() after each report is saved, and again after a board correction so the stored board_label is updated.
Call reset_index() after rebuilding the index files.
Similarity is context for the user, not a classification or a fact check.
